name: Prosciutto
siboNotes: Plain prosciutto is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated. Choose varieties without added onion or garlic seasonings.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels to avoid varieties with garlic or onion powder
Serve at room temperature for best flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP cheeses and fruits
Use as a protein wrap for vegetables or cheese
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
